reviewer: Claude Opus 5, WP3 route-authz lane (evidence run executed by the integration owner, automated session)
reviewedChange: Swapped getActiveWorkspace for requireRouteProjectId. The accessor's third fallback returned LEGACY_WORKSPACE_ID, a real workspace holding real tasks for which the caller had produced no membership proof (D-005), so a caller belonging to nothing could be shown another tenant's archive. requireRouteProjectId stops at the first-membership fallback and redirects to /welcome instead. No explicit workspaceId parameter is accepted here on purpose: this page renders inside TasksRuntimeShell, which is mounted from a layout, and a Next.js layout receives no searchParams, so accepting one would let the URL and the chrome name different Projects. Rendered output for an authorized caller is unchanged.
